settings.label: Secondary circular monogram
settings.info: Upload the official circular DearBody PH mark as a transparent PNG. Its silhouette adapts to burgundy or cream for contrast. Leave empty for the bundled vector recreation.

settings.content: Bauhaus edition. Approved palette: burgundy #5c0006, red #9a1106, orange #d46601, golden tan #e9a250 and cream #f4e3cb. The primary wordmark appears in the header; the secondary circular monogram appears in the story and footer. Helvetica Neue is the fallback until licensed brand webfonts are installed.
Select the existing women’s and men’s collections. If unset, navigation looks for collections titled Women's Perfume / Men's Perfume or For Her / For Him.
